prompt:
Task packet (llm-eval, ~/Workspace/llm-eval). Replace the skipped placeholders for smoke and vision with real trials.
- Add `fixtures/smoke-1.json`: kind `smoke`, prompt exactly "Reply with the single word OK.", run for every profile at the selected context; it passes when the reply contains OK. Record it in a `<model>__smoke` section.
- Add `fixtures/vision-1.json`: kind `vision`, an image spec `{"quadrants": ["red", "green", "blue", "yellow"]}`, a prompt asking for the four colours one per line in reading order, and `expected` lines; grade it like recall (exact lines in order). - New module `llm_eval/images.py`: `COLORS` (colour name -> RGB tuple), `quadrants_png(names, size)` returning PNG bytes of a `size` x `size` image whose four quadrants take `names` left to right, top to bottom (8-bit RGB, a single IDAT, filter byte 0 on every row), and `data_uri(png)`. The runner builds the image at run time, not in the fixture.
- The live adapter sends a vision request as one user message whose content is `[{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": <data URI>}}, {"type": "text", "text": <prompt>}]`.
Done when `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes from the project folder. Keep existing tests' assertions as they are.
